messages:
maya: Heads up: PR #2671 (kvcache refactor) is blocked by a couple style/lint nits — mostly initialisms and a gofmt issue. Need 1 more approver after fixes. https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/2671

sam: I saw the CI failure — `gofmt` changed files and golangci-lint flags an initialism: `Requestid` vs `RequestID`. Small changes, but want to make sure we follow the project convention.

lee: I can take a quick look after formatting. For initialisms we do `ID`, `HTTP`, `KV` uppercase in exported names. Keep JSON tags snake_case (`request_id`) if consumers expect that.

maya: OK. I'll push a formatting + initialism fix. Local command I run: ```
$ gofmt -w ./pkg/serving
$ golangci-lint run --fix
$ git add -A && git commit -m "style: fmt and initialism fixes"
``` Will that re-trigger CI automatically? @ci-bot

ci-bot: CI: New pushes to branch `feat/kvcache-refactor` will trigger a full job. Current status: failing checks -> waiting for new push.

sam: Also saw a linter nit about an exported field missing a doc comment on `RequestID`. Either add a one-line comment or make it unexported if it's internal.

maya: Good call. I'll add: `// RequestID is the unique request identifier used for tracing.` to pkg/serving/types.go and push.

lee: :+1: ping me after the push and I'll do the final pass.

maya: Pushed fixes (commit 3bf1a2e). PTAL.

ci-bot: CI: Build started for commit 3bf1a2e. Unit tests: 34/34 passed. Integration: 8/8 passed. Linters: passed.

sam: LGTM, approving now. :shipit: 

lee: LGTM as well, approved.

pr-bot: PR #2671 merged into main by maya (merge commit 9d1f5e).

maya: Merged and deployed to staging. Thanks all! :tada:
